description: B2B technology consultancy offering digital transformation, cloud migration, and custom software development
target_audience: CTOs and IT directors at mid-market companies (50-500 employees)

goals.primary_goals: Qualified lead generation, brand authority in cloud migration

products.competitive_advantages: Deep AWS expertise, UK-based team, case studies with measurable ROI
products.ad_notes: LinkedIn Ads targeting CTO/VP Engineering titles. Budget: 2000 GBP/month.

seasonality.description: B2B cycle: budget planning in Q4 drives Q1 inquiries. Summer slowdown July-August.

gaps.specific_problem: Blog traffic growing but not converting to leads — content-to-conversion gap
gaps.additional_notes: Sales cycle is 3-6 months. Website form submissions are only the first step — followed by discovery call, proposal, negotiation.

competitors.name: Kinly
competitors.notes: Larger company, broader service offering, stronger brand presence

what_changed.campaign_changes: New LinkedIn campaign targeting financial services CTOs launched March 10. Paused generic 'cloud services' Google Ads campaign (low quality leads).
what_changed.site_changes: Published 3 new case studies in March. Redesigned services page with clearer CTAs. Added Calendly integration for discovery calls.
what_changed.technical_changes: Added scroll_depth and form_interaction custom events. LinkedIn Insight tag updated to new version.
what_changed.external_factors: AWS re:Invent announcements driving increased search interest in cloud migration.
